stem.text: Which statement about the compounds of the Group 2 metals is correct?

A.text: Barium carbonate is less thermally stable than strontium carbonate.

B.text: Barium sulfate is less soluble than magnesium sulfate.

C.text: Calcium hydroxide is less soluble than magnesium hydroxide.

D.text: Calcium nitrate is more thermally stable than strontium nitrate.
